name: MemOS Markdown Memory
description: Tree-structured markdown memory with local embedding search. Stores memories as human-readable .md files. No database required.

bridgePort.description: Port for the Python memory bridge (default 18832)

chatModel.description: LLM model for memory extraction (default deepseek/deepseek-chat)

notes: Requires Python 3.10+ with MemOS installed (pip install memos or from source)
Set OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_BASE_URL for LLM memory extraction
Memory files stored at ~/.openclaw/memos-markdown/ as human-readable .md files
